purpose: Response-flatness measurement: the natural-phrasing matrix sampled one point of the input-phrasing distribution; this file fixes four further points per task (formal EN, casual EN, Chinese, terse) with ground truths inherited verbatim, so routing, extraction and disposition stability can be measured across phrasings.
runner_note: The evaluation runner keys samples by task id; when executing this file, extend the sample key to task_id__variant_id and record llm_calls exactly as in the natural matrix.

primary_endpoints: per-variant routing accuracy and disposition match against the same expected values
hard escape count == 0 across all variants
secondary_endpoints: variance of six-dimension scores across variants of the same task (response flatness)
pipeline vs model-in-loop stratum shares per variant
analysis_plan.note: Chinese variants also measure language robustness of routing signals that were authored in English.
